data.one_liner: Dynamically switch app launcher icons on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows a Flutter app to change its launcher icon at runtime. It supports querying the current icon and setting a new one. The plugin requires platform‑specific setup for activity aliases on Android and alternate app icons on iOS.
use_when: You need multiple launcher icons for different app states or themes
You want to change the icon without reinstalling the app
You need to show a different icon for a paid version or feature toggle
avoid_when: You only need a single static icon
You are targeting web or desktop platforms
strengths: Handles platform setup instructions in README
weaknesses: No support for dynamic icon changes on web/desktop
data.setup_notes: Add activity aliases in AndroidManifest.xml and enable alternate icons in Xcode Build Settings. No build_runner or permissions needed.
